name: kneeling glute press
description: A kneeling move pressing one leg back to fire the glute. Great for learning to feel the glutes work.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
